headline: xAI launches Grok Voice 3.0, tops independent voice ranking
dek: The new speech model scores 86.9 on an independent index and already runs in Tesla and Starlink, xAI says.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: First place in independent testing
body: xAI launched Grok Voice 3.0, a speech-to-speech model it calls the most intelligent of its kind available today (xAI, SiliconANGLE).
Artificial Analysis scored it 86.9 on its Speech-to-Speech Index, first among the voice models it tracks (xAI, SiliconANGLE).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: How it compares
s3.body: On the same index, according to SiliconANGLE, rivals scored below Grok Voice 3.0.

points.t: OpenAI's model scored 83.2 on the index (SiliconANGLE).
On noisy support calls, Grok scored 71.6% and OpenAI 74.5% (SiliconANGLE).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Cheaper per task
body: On Big Bench Audio, SiliconANGLE cites about 2.5 cents per task for Grok Voice 3.0, versus 3 cents for GPT-Live-1 and 5.5 for GPT-Realtime-2.1.
On ServiceNow's EVA-Bench, the model reached 74% accuracy, the highest score among those tested (xAI, SiliconANGLE).

items.t: According to xAI, it handles millions of conversations a day in Tesla cars.
It answers about 20,000 calls a day; 70% are resolved without a human (xAI, SiliconANGLE).
$0.08 per minute in the API, same as Grok Voice 2.0 (xAI, SiliconANGLE).

caption.hook: xAI launched Grok Voice 3.0, which tops Artificial Analysis's voice ranking with a score of 86.9.
body: According to xAI and SiliconANGLE, OpenAI's GPT-Live-1 scored 83.2 and Google's Gemini 3.8 Live scored 82.6. On noisy, accented support calls, Grok trailed OpenAI slightly: 71.6% versus 74.5%.

The model costs about 2.5 cents per task on Big Bench Audio, versus 3 cents for GPT-Live-1. xAI says it already handles millions of conversations a day in Tesla cars and about 20,000 daily calls at Starlink. In the API, the price is $0.08 per minute.
